description: Creates a share link (share token) for a page or folder, with optional expiry, recipient name and password. Anyone with the link (and the password, if set) can open it. Returns { token, url, expiresAt, passphraseProtected, recipient }.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link expires (null = never)

passphrase.description: Optional password (4-256 characters) the recipient must enter to open the link. Stored hashed; send it to the recipient through another channel

recipient.description: Who the link is for (e.g. 'Laura · Acme'). One link per person: each open is recorded under that name in outbox_page_views

resource.description: Slug/path of the page or folder to share

name: outbox_create_share
title: Outbox: create a share link
